async function wrapUserDataLayer() {
	// Get registered and subscribed status from cookies.

		return row.startsWith( 'fp.user=' );
	} );
	let wrapUserRegistered = false;
	let wrapUserSubscribed = false;

	// sync with wrapUserRegistered/wrapUserSubscribed above rather than derived
	// separately, so the two never disagree for the same visitor.
	let wrapFlipPayId = '';
	let wrapFlipPayStatus = 'anonymous';
	let wrapAccessToken = '';
	if ( fpUserCookie ) {
		try {
			let fpUser = JSON.parse( decodeURIComponent( fpUserCookie.split( '=' ).slice( 1 ).join( '=' ) ) );
			if ( fpUser && typeof fpUser.access_token === 'string' && fpUser.access_token.trim() !== '' ) {
				wrapUserRegistered = true;
				wrapAccessToken = fpUser.access_token.trim();
			}
		} catch ( e ) {}
	}

	if ( wrapAccessToken !== '' && window.theWrap && typeof window.theWrap.checkSubscriberStatus === 'function' ) {
		let identity = await window.theWrap.checkSubscriberStatus( wrapAccessToken );
		wrapUserSubscribed = identity.hasEntitlements;
		wrapFlipPayId = identity.id;
		wrapFlipPayStatus = identity.status;
	} else if ( wrapAccessToken === '' && window.theWrap && typeof window.theWrap.clearSubscriberStatus === 'function' ) {
		// No access token means the user is not logged in, so clear any subscriber status that may have been set previously.
		window.theWrap.clearSubscriberStatus();

	// already pushed from a cached cookie -- correcting it if the cache was stale, or
	// supplying it for the first time if there was no cache yet. Otherwise this would
	// push the same values a second time for no reason.
	let earlyIdentity = window.wrapFlipPayEarlyIdentity;
	let identityUnchanged = earlyIdentity &&
		earlyIdentity.registered === wrapUserRegistered &&
		earlyIdentity.subscribed === wrapUserSubscribed &&
		earlyIdentity.id === wrapFlipPayId &&
		earlyIdentity.status === wrapFlipPayStatus;

	if ( ! identityUnchanged ) {
		window.dataLayer.push( { wrapUserRegistered: wrapUserRegistered } );
		window.dataLayer.push( { wrapSubscriptionActive: wrapUserSubscribed } );

		// there is an ID to send, so a GTM variable reading it resolves to undefined

async function wrapUserDataLayer() {
	// Get registered and subscribed status from cookies.
	let fpUserCookie = document.cookie.split( '; ' ).find( function( row ) {
		return row.startsWith( 'fp.user=' );
	} );
	let wrapUserRegistered = false;
	let wrapUserSubscribed = false;
	// GA4 identity for Sophi (WRAPM-1294): account ID and audience status, kept in
	// sync with wrapUserRegistered/wrapUserSubscribed above rather than derived
	// separately, so the two never disagree for the same visitor.
	let wrapFlipPayId = '';
	let wrapFlipPayStatus = 'anonymous';
	let wrapAccessToken = '';
	if ( fpUserCookie ) {
		try {
			let fpUser = JSON.parse( decodeURIComponent( fpUserCookie.split( '=' ).slice( 1 ).join( '=' ) ) );
			if ( fpUser && typeof fpUser.access_token === 'string' && fpUser.access_token.trim() !== '' ) {
				wrapUserRegistered = true;
				wrapAccessToken = fpUser.access_token.trim();
			}
		} catch ( e ) {}
	}

	if ( wrapAccessToken !== '' && window.theWrap && typeof window.theWrap.checkSubscriberStatus === 'function' ) {
		let identity = await window.theWrap.checkSubscriberStatus( wrapAccessToken );
		wrapUserSubscribed = identity.hasEntitlements;
		wrapFlipPayId = identity.id;
		wrapFlipPayStatus = identity.status;
	} else if ( wrapAccessToken === '' && window.theWrap && typeof window.theWrap.clearSubscriberStatus === 'function' ) {
		// No access token means the user is not logged in, so clear any subscriber status that may have been set previously.
		window.theWrap.clearSubscriberStatus();
	}

	window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];

	// Only push the identity if it differs from what parts/flip-pay-early-datalayer.php
	// already pushed from a cached cookie -- correcting it if the cache was stale, or
	// supplying it for the first time if there was no cache yet. Otherwise this would
	// push the same values a second time for no reason.
	let earlyIdentity = window.wrapFlipPayEarlyIdentity;
	let identityUnchanged = earlyIdentity &&
		earlyIdentity.registered === wrapUserRegistered &&
		earlyIdentity.subscribed === wrapUserSubscribed &&
		earlyIdentity.id === wrapFlipPayId &&
		earlyIdentity.status === wrapFlipPayStatus;

	if ( ! identityUnchanged ) {
		window.dataLayer.push( { wrapUserRegistered: wrapUserRegistered } );
		window.dataLayer.push( { wrapSubscriptionActive: wrapUserSubscribed } );
		// No GA4 User-ID is sent for an anonymous visitor: the key is only pushed once
		// there is an ID to send, so a GTM variable reading it resolves to undefined
		// rather than an empty string.
		if ( wrapFlipPayId !== '' ) {
			window.dataLayer.push( { user_id: wrapFlipPayId } );
		}
		window.dataLayer.push( { wrapFlipPayStatus: wrapFlipPayStatus } );
	}

	let fpBrowserSessionCookie = document.cookie.split( '; ' ).find( function( row ) {
		return row.startsWith( 'fp.browser_session_id=' );

		let wrapTrackingID = fpBrowserSessionCookie.split( '=' ).slice( 1 ).join( '=' );

	// separately, so the two never disagree for the same visitor.

				wrapUserRegistered = true;
				wrapAccessToken = fpUser.access_token.trim();
			}

	}

	if ( wrapAccessToken !== '' && window.theWrap && typeof window.theWrap.checkSubscriberStatus === 'function' ) {
		let identity = await window.theWrap.checkSubscriberStatus( wrapAccessToken );
		wrapUserSubscribed = identity.hasEntitlements;
		wrapFlipPayId = identity.id;
		wrapFlipPayStatus = identity.status;
	} else if ( wrapAccessToken === '' && window.theWrap && typeof window.theWrap.clearSubscriberStatus === 'function' ) {

	// push the same values a second time for no reason.
	let earlyIdentity = window.wrapFlipPayEarlyIdentity;
	let identityUnchanged = earlyIdentity &&
		earlyIdentity.registered === wrapUserRegistered &&
		earlyIdentity.subscribed === wrapUserSubscribed &&
		earlyIdentity.id === wrapFlipPayId &&
		earlyIdentity.status === wrapFlipPayStatus;

		window.dataLayer.push( { wrapUserRegistered: wrapUserRegistered } );
		window.dataLayer.push( { wrapSubscriptionActive: wrapUserSubscribed } );

		return row.startsWith( 'fp.user=' );

	let wrapUserSubscribed = false;

	// sync with wrapUserRegistered/wrapUserSubscribed above rather than derived
	// separately, so the two never disagree for the same visitor.

	let wrapFlipPayStatus = 'anonymous';

		try {
			let fpUser = JSON.parse( decodeURIComponent( fpUserCookie.split( '=' ).slice( 1 ).join( '=' ) ) );
			if ( fpUser && typeof fpUser.access_token === 'string' && fpUser.access_token.trim() !== '' ) {
				wrapUserRegistered = true;
				wrapAccessToken = fpUser.access_token.trim();
			}
		} catch ( e ) {}
	}

	if ( wrapAccessToken !== '' && window.theWrap && typeof window.theWrap.checkSubscriberStatus === 'function' ) {
		let identity = await window.theWrap.checkSubscriberStatus( wrapAccessToken );
		wrapUserSubscribed = identity.hasEntitlements;
		wrapFlipPayId = identity.id;
		wrapFlipPayStatus = identity.status;
	} else if ( wrapAccessToken === '' && window.theWrap && typeof window.theWrap.clearSubscriberStatus === 'function' ) {

	// already pushed from a cached cookie -- correcting it if the cache was stale, or
	// supplying it for the first time if there was no cache yet. Otherwise this would
	// push the same values a second time for no reason.
	let earlyIdentity = window.wrapFlipPayEarlyIdentity;
	let identityUnchanged = earlyIdentity &&
		earlyIdentity.registered === wrapUserRegistered &&
		earlyIdentity.subscribed === wrapUserSubscribed &&
		earlyIdentity.id === wrapFlipPayId &&
		earlyIdentity.status === wrapFlipPayStatus;

	if ( ! identityUnchanged ) {
		window.dataLayer.push( { wrapUserRegistered: wrapUserRegistered } );
		window.dataLayer.push( { wrapSubscriptionActive: wrapUserSubscribed } );

<script>
async function wrapUserDataLayer() {
	// Get registered and subscribed status from cookies.
	let fpUserCookie = document.cookie.split( '; ' ).find( function( row ) {
		return row.startsWith( 'fp.user=' );
	} );
	let wrapUserRegistered = false;
	let wrapUserSubscribed = false;
	// GA4 identity for Sophi (WRAPM-1294): account ID and audience status, kept in
	// sync with wrapUserRegistered/wrapUserSubscribed above rather than derived
	// separately, so the two never disagree for the same visitor.
	let wrapFlipPayId = '';
	let wrapFlipPayStatus = 'anonymous';
	let wrapAccessToken = '';
	if ( fpUserCookie ) {
		try {
			let fpUser = JSON.parse( decodeURIComponent( fpUserCookie.split( '=' ).slice( 1 ).join( '=' ) ) );
			if ( fpUser && typeof fpUser.access_token === 'string' && fpUser.access_token.trim() !== '' ) {
				wrapUserRegistered = true;
				wrapAccessToken = fpUser.access_token.trim();
			}
		} catch ( e ) {}
	}

	if ( wrapAccessToken !== '' && window.theWrap && typeof window.theWrap.checkSubscriberStatus === 'function' ) {
		let identity = await window.theWrap.checkSubscriberStatus( wrapAccessToken );
		wrapUserSubscribed = identity.hasEntitlements;
		wrapFlipPayId = identity.id;
		wrapFlipPayStatus = identity.status;
	} else if ( wrapAccessToken === '' && window.theWrap && typeof window.theWrap.clearSubscriberStatus === 'function' ) {
		// No access token means the user is not logged in, so clear any subscriber status that may have been set previously.
		window.theWrap.clearSubscriberStatus();
	}

	window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];

	// Only push the identity if it differs from what parts/flip-pay-early-datalayer.php
	// already pushed from a cached cookie -- correcting it if the cache was stale, or
	// supplying it for the first time if there was no cache yet. Otherwise this would
	// push the same values a second time for no reason.
	let earlyIdentity = window.wrapFlipPayEarlyIdentity;
	let identityUnchanged = earlyIdentity &&
		earlyIdentity.registered === wrapUserRegistered &&
		earlyIdentity.subscribed === wrapUserSubscribed &&
		earlyIdentity.id === wrapFlipPayId &&
		earlyIdentity.status === wrapFlipPayStatus;

	if ( ! identityUnchanged ) {
		window.dataLayer.push( { wrapUserRegistered: wrapUserRegistered } );
		window.dataLayer.push( { wrapSubscriptionActive: wrapUserSubscribed } );
		// No GA4 User-ID is sent for an anonymous visitor: the key is only pushed once
		// there is an ID to send, so a GTM variable reading it resolves to undefined
		// rather than an empty string.
		if ( wrapFlipPayId !== '' ) {
			window.dataLayer.push( { user_id: wrapFlipPayId } );
		}
		window.dataLayer.push( { wrapFlipPayStatus: wrapFlipPayStatus } );
	}

	// Get the session ID from a cookie and push it to the dataLayer for tracking purposes.
	let fpBrowserSessionCookie = document.cookie.split( '; ' ).find( function( row ) {
		return row.startsWith( 'fp.browser_session_id=' );
	} );

		let wrapTrackingID = fpBrowserSessionCookie.split( '=' ).slice( 1 ).join( '=' );
		wrapTrackingID = wrapTrackingID.replace( /^"|"$/g, '' ); // Remove quotes if present.
		window.dataLayer.push( { wrapTrackingID: wrapTrackingID } );
	}

}

});
